what: One layer of the steer lens timed on the home RTX 5090 (29 October 2026, 00:26-00:31 CDT): `atlas_build.py steer` at layer 45 (layers from 0), --unpacker compiled, written into a scratch folder and not served. Quoted in COMPUTE §i and ROADMAP §vi.
what_it_ran: build_steer_layer pushes each batch of neurons, both signs, on four contexts, and runs only the layers after the pushed one (backend/atlas_build.py: ao.forward_from_layer(lm, l + 1, ...); atlas_ops.forward_from_layer loops from start to the last layer). Layer 45 of 0-59 runs the 14 after it.

all_60_inferred.rule: a layer's cost grows with the layers after it: layer l runs 59 - l of them, 1,770 layer-forwards over all 60, against 60 x 14 = 840 were every layer like layer 45
all_60_inferred.beside: scripts/pod/pod_tool.py projects the same timing as 287 x sum(60 - l) / (60 - 45) s = 9.7 hours, counting the pushed layer's own per-batch work as one more
all_60_inferred.status: inferred, not run: time a shallow layer (layer 5, say) to check
